root.name: BackTrackBB
root.description: Multi-band array detection and location of seismic sources. BackTrackBB is a program for detection and space-time location of seismic sources based on multi-scale, frequency-selective statistical coherence of the wave field recorded by dense large-scale seismic networks and local antennas. The method is designed to enhance coherence of the signal statistical features across the array of sensors and consists of three steps. They are signal processing, space-time imaging and detection and location.
